templates.template: DGX Spark GB10 by host collector
templates.name: DGX Spark GB10 by host collector
templates.description: DGX Spark / NVIDIA GB10. Linux HOST collector + read-only JSON for containerized Agent 2. Base format 7.0; target deployment reported as Server 7.0.31 and Agent 2 7.4.15 (live validation pending). Default service candidates include Ollama, vLLM, ComfyUI, llama.cpp, LM Studio, SGLang and TensorFold TCP/8888; ports are configured in the host collector JSON, not this export. UMA RAM is not dedicated VRAM. Unsupported NVIDIA values are omitted. Power is the NVIDIA-reported domain, not wall power. See README.md.

triggers.expression: nodata(/DGX Spark GB10 by host collector/dgx.timestamp,{$DGX.STALE})=1 or fuzzytime(/DGX Spark GB10 by host collector/dgx.timestamp,{$DGX.STALE})=0
triggers.name: DGX: host snapshot missing, stale or clock out of sync

triggers.expression: min(/DGX Spark GB10 by host collector/dgx.errors,{$DGX.WINDOW})>0 and fuzzytime(/DGX Spark GB10 by host collector/dgx.timestamp,{$DGX.STALE})=1
triggers.name: DGX: persistent collector errors; check diagnostics

triggers.expression: max(/DGX Spark GB10 by host collector/dgx.summary[gpu_query_ok],{$DGX.WINDOW})=0 and fuzzytime(/DGX Spark GB10 by host collector/dgx.timestamp,{$DGX.STALE})=1
triggers.name: DGX: nvidia-smi query failing
